map.基础代谢率 BMR 使用指南: Basal metabolic rate BMR user guide
map.基础代谢率 BMR 计算器。输入身高、体重、年龄与性别，按 Mifflin-St: Basal metabolic rate BMR calculator: enter height, weight, age and sex, estimate daily basal metabolic calories by Mifflin-St Jeor etc., for calorie management and fat/muscle energy baseline.
map.减脂/增肌前测算基础代谢率 BMR，再乘活动系数得 TDEE，制定热量目标。: Before fat loss/muscle gain, estimate BMR, then multiply activity factor for TDEE, set calorie goal.
map.对比不同活动量下的每日总消耗，直观看到运动对总能耗的贡献。: Compare daily total expenditure at different activity levels, intuitively see exercise contribution to total energy.
map.长期体重管理随访中跟踪 BMR 变化（随体重/年龄），及时调整饮食。: In long-term weight-management follow-up, track BMR changes (with weight/age) and adjust diet in time.
map.：输入：男性、30 岁、身高 175 cm、体重 70 kg。\nBMR=10×:
: input: male, 30 years, height 175 cm, weight 70 kg.
BMR = 10 x 70 + 6.25 x 175 - 5 x 30 + 5 = 700 + 1093.75 - 150 + 5 = 1648.75 approx 1649 kcal.
TDEE by activity: sedentary 1.2 -> 1979, light 1.375 -> 2267, moderate 1.55 -> 2556, high 1.725 -> 2845, very high 1.9 -> 3133 kcal.
Conclusion: this man rests at about 1649 kcal/day, moderate activity total about 2556 kcal, fat loss can be set at about 2050-2250 kcal/day.
map.本工具采用 Mifflin-St Jeor（1990），对现代人群精度优于经典: This tool uses Mifflin-St Jeor (1990), which is more accurate than the classic Harris-Benedict for modern populations and is recommended by most guidelines; the two formulas usually differ by <5% and can be used as cross-reference.
map.不建议。BMR 是完全静息最低消耗，长期摄入低于 BMR 会触发代谢下降、肌肉流: Not recommended. BMR is the minimum resting consumption; long-term intake below BMR triggers metabolic slowdown and muscle loss; fat loss should create a 300-500 kcal deficit based on TDEE, not diet below BMR.
